sentences.en: Politicians are always censured for outrageous or inappropriate behavior.
sentences.zh: 政客们总是因为行为不当或不合适而受到指责。

sentences.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
sentences.zh: 这位参议员被国会道德委员会谴责了。

sentences.en: I proposed a vote of censure on the government.
sentences.zh: 我提议对政府进行谴责投票。
